info.name: Get Information for a Historical Flight

params.name: ident
params.description:
The ident, registration, or fa_flight_id to fetch. If using
a flight ident, it is highly recommended to specify ICAO flight
ident rather than IATA flight ident to avoid ambiguity and unexpected results.
Setting the ident_type can also be used to help disambiguate.

params.name: ident_type
params.description:
Type of ident provided in the ident parameter. By default, the passed
ident is interpreted as a registration if possible. This parameter can
force the ident to be interpreted as a designator instead.

params.name: start
params.description:
The starting date range for flight results, comparing against flights'
`scheduled_out` field (or `scheduled_off` if `scheduled_out` is
missing). The format is ISO8601 date or datetime, and the bound is
inclusive. Specified start date must occur on or after 2011-01-01 00:00:00 UTC
and cannot be in the future. If using date instead of datetime, the
time will default to 00:00:00Z.

params.name: end
params.description:
The ending date range for flight results, comparing against flights'
`scheduled_out` field (or `scheduled_off` if `scheduled_out` is
missing). The format is ISO8601 date or datetime, and the bound is
exclusive. Specified end date must occur after 2011-01-01 00:00:00 UTC
and cannot be in the future. If using date instead of datetime, the
time will default to 00:00:00Z.

params.name: max_pages
params.description: Maximum number of pages to fetch. This is an upper limit and not a guarantee of how many pages will be returned.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque value used to get the next batch of data from a paged collection.

items.docs:
Returns historical flight info status summary for a registration, ident,
or fa_flight_id. If a fa_flight_id is specified then a maximum of 1
flight is returned, unless the flight has been diverted in which case
both the original flight and any diversions will be returned with a
duplicate fa_flight_id. If a registraion or ident is specified then a
start_date and end_date must be specified. The span between start_date
and end_date can be up to 7 days. No more than 40 pages may be requested
at once

info.name: Get Historical Information for a Flight's Track

params.name: include_estimated_positions
params.description: Whether to include estimated positions in the flight track

items.docs:
Returns the track for a historical flight as an array of positions.
Data is available from now back to 2011-01-01T00:00:00Z.

info.name: Get an Image of a Historical Flight's Track on a Map

params.name: layer_on
params.description: List of map layers to enable

params.name: layer_off
params.description: List of map layers to disable

params.name: show_data_block
params.description:
Whether a textual caption containing the ident, type, heading,
altitude, origin, and destination should be displayed by the flight's
position.

params.name: airports_expand_view
params.description:
Whether to force zoom area to ensure origin/destination airports are
visible. Enabling this flag forcefully enables the show_airports flag
as well.

params.name: show_airports
params.description:
Whether to show the origin/destination airports for the flight as
labeled points on the map.

params.name: bounding_box
params.description:
Manually specify the zoom area of the map using custom bounds. Should
be a list of 4 coordinates representing the top, right, bottom, and
left sides of the area (in that order).

items.docs:
Returns a historical flight's track as a base64-encoded image. Image can contain a
variety of additional data layers beyond just the track. Data is available from now back to
2011-01-01T00:00:00Z.

Returns information about a historical flight's filed route including
coordinates, names, and types of fixes along the route.  Not all flight
routes can be successfully decoded by this endpoint, particularly if the
flight is not entirely within the continental U.S. airspace, since this function
only has access to navaids within that area. If data on a waypoint is
missing then the type will be listed as "UNKNOWN". Data is available from now back to
2011-01-01T00:00:00Z.

params.name: registration
params.description: The registration number of the aircraft to fetch

items.docs:
Returns flight info status summary for an aircraft's last known flight
given its registration. The search is limited to flights flown since
January 1, 2011. On a successful response, the body will contain a
flights array with only 1 element. If a user queries a registration with
it's last known flight before January 1, 2011, an empty flights array will
be returned.
